governing_rule: Each P0 from the triage must be independently verified against broker truth, not self-reported status.

broker_evidence.note: tp=0 is by design (R4 uses signal-based exits, not TP). SL is set on all positions.

p0_findings.title: No layer can reduce live exposure automatically
p0_findings.evidence: All 19 positions now have catastrophic SL set (SL != 0). Catastrophic protection layer (2×ATR14 or 1% floor) is active. Emergency flatten exists with --flatten flag. However, auto-flatten on drawdown breach is still not implemented (remains P1).
p0_findings.remaining_risk: Drawdown-triggered auto-flatten not yet implemented. Current protection is: (1) broker-side SL on every position, (2) watchdog escalation, (3) manual --flatten. Gap: no automated exit when drawdown exceeds 10% threshold.

p0_findings.title: 10% drawdown gate breached with zero reaction
p0_findings.evidence: Daily loss tracking is now persisted across cycles (runtime_state.json). Peak equity tracked. Bridge outage detection via watchdog (stale_after=300s, blind_after=900s, contain_after=3600s). Current daily loss: $0.00, remaining budget: $250.
p0_findings.remaining_risk: Bridge outage during a cycle still creates a blind window up to loop_interval (3600s). Watchdog escalation to CONTAIN is implemented but requires the monitor process to be running.

p0_findings.title: Campaign boundary compromised by foreign positions + PQ misattestation
p0_findings.evidence: Current broker state shows 0 foreign positions. All 19 positions are magic=20260825 (R4 bot). Foreign positions were closed (visible in mt5_deals_live.json). Multi-factor foreign detection now implemented (magic + symbol allowlist).
p0_findings.remaining_risk: Foreign positions could reappear if account is shared or manual trades are placed. Multi-factor detection catches this every cycle and raises WARNING. Full resolution requires account isolation (no manual trading on the same account).

p0_findings.title: Deployment drift: live process predates audited HEAD
p0_findings.evidence: Build manifest git_head: 375a71b (2026-08-27T06:31Z). Current git HEAD: 41a53f3. The live process has NOT been restarted to pick up audit resolution commits (EC-AUD-001 timeout, EC-AUD-002 force-regime block, EC-AUD-003 quarantine, mypy fixes, etc.). Fingerprint verification is running against the OLD binary.
p0_findings.required_action: Restart the live loop process to pick up current HEAD. After restart, build manifest will update to current HEAD and fingerprint verification will run against the correct binary.
p0_findings.risk_of_not_acting: The safety improvements committed in v0.2.0 (order timeout, force-regime blocking, config validation, quarantined r4_live_orders.py) are NOT active in the running process. The process is running code from before the audit resolution.

p1_findings.title: Per-position loss limit declared but unimplemented
p1_findings.note: Catastrophic SL (2×ATR14 or 1% floor) provides per-position protection. Per-position P&L monitoring during the cycle is not implemented.

p1_findings.title: Midnight zero-equity baseline poisoning
p1_findings.note: Daily loss baseline now persists from runtime_state.json across cycles. Baseline equity is $7,011.57 (not zero).

p1_findings.title: Regime-OFF leaves existing positions unmanaged
p1_findings.note: R4 uses signal-based exits (rotation), not regime-based exits. When regime turns OFF, no new entries are allowed but existing positions continue to be managed by the next signal cycle.

p1_findings.title: Alert amplification + no acting escalation channel
p1_findings.note: Alert deduplication added (structured_alerts.py). Telegram webhook configured. Still requires a human to act on alerts.

p1_findings.title: Three divergent regime definitions break fidelity
p1_findings.note: Regime definition unified. Research/15 symbols vs live/31 symbols vs monitor/6 symbols — monitor now uses the same universe as the live loop.
